sents.en: Tall or short, this shape curves round.
sents.ko: 크든 작든 이 모양은 둥글게 휘어요.

sents.en: Where can cylinders be found?
The same size round base is on each end.
sents.ko: 양쪽 끝에 같은 크기의 둥근 밑면이 있어요.

sents.en: Cylinder sides are one curving bend.
sents.ko: 원기둥의 옆면은 하나로 둥글게 휘어져 있어요.

sents.en: Look around for this shape's look.
Search for cylinders in this book.
Ben sees cylinders in the store.
Tall stacks of cans are by the door.
sents.ko: 문 옆에 통조림이 높이 쌓여 있어요.

sents.en: Jill finds rolls of towels and tape.
Both things have a cylinder shape!
Cylinders of windows to the sky.
Cylinder poles reach just as high!
Ben likes to go down the cylinder slide.
sents.ko: 벤은 원기둥 미끄럼틀을 타고 내려가는 걸 좋아해요.

sents.en: In cylinder tunnels, Jill likes to hide.
sents.ko: 질은 원기둥 터널에 숨는 걸 좋아해요.

sents.en: Cows eat grass on the farm all day.
sents.ko: 소들이 농장에서 하루 종일 풀을 먹어요.

sents.en: Sheep graze on cylinders of hay.
sents.ko: 양들은 원기둥 모양 건초를 뜯어 먹어요.

sents.en: Here are cylinders on top of brooms.
Nice round handles for sweeping rooms.
Time for a snack and a nice cool drink.
White cylinder cheese and juice that's pink.
Cylinders aren't just in this book.
sents.ko: 원기둥은 이 책 안에만 있는 게 아니에요.

sents.en: They're all around you.
Take a look!
Hmm, many items have the cylinder shape, such as toilet paper, or telescope.
sents.ko: 음, 원기둥 모양인 게 많아요. 화장지나 망원경처럼요.

sents.en: What else can you think of?
Let's find some cylinders together.
Oh, I found one.
Where can you find one?
I'll see you next time! Good-bye!
